classifications.current_target_fact: The current target validates P0-P9 observations but has no network executor and cannot directly observe DNS separately from TCP.
classifications.disposition: Define a bounded resolver observation and single resolved-address connection contract. Keep implementation blocked until contract, negative tests and security accountability are separately reviewed.

classifications.current_target_fact: No TLS stack or network binding exists in the target.
classifications.disposition: Require system trust-store verification, original allowlisted hostname verification and SNI; reject disabled verification.

classifications.current_target_fact: No TLS stack exists and no certificate-pinning policy has been adopted.
classifications.disposition: Do not mandate pinning by default. It requires a separate threat model plus certificate rotation, rollback and outage handling.

classifications.current_target_fact: The target exposes no credential fields and reads no credential.
classifications.disposition: A future binding may read only the named variable at request construction and must never persist or log credential, Authorization, environment dumps or raw bodies.

classifications.current_target_fact: No supported operation, credential store, security contact or rotation owner exists.
classifications.disposition: Define rotation, revocation, expiry and incident ownership before supported operation; do not claim secret-manager integration now.

classifications.current_target_fact: The target has no response reader; PRE-50 proposed but did not implement a 1048576-byte limit.
classifications.disposition: Enforce a cumulative 1048576-byte limit while reading; fail before unbounded buffering and retain no raw body.

classifications.current_target_fact: The target currently serializes bounded sanitized metadata and has no Provider error body.
classifications.disposition: Retain only approved enums, HTTP status, bounded counts, digests and opaque references; never retain Provider error body, prompt, review content or hidden reasoning.

classifications.current_target_fact: Target project dependencies are empty; httpcore==1.0.9 is a planning candidate only.
classifications.disposition: Keep the exact pin as a candidate until license, artifact hash, vulnerability and transitive dependency review are complete.

classifications.current_target_fact: Two offline builds passed but artifact hashes differed; no SBOM or reproducible-build proof exists.
classifications.disposition: Require lock/provenance, artifact hashes, SBOM and reproducible-build evidence before release; keep current Development reference non-released.

classifications.current_target_fact: Current contract preserves one first failure and prohibits silent retry, fallback, substitution and repair.
classifications.disposition: Keep automatic retry, fallback, redirect, model substitution, alias inference and JSON repair disabled for the bounded profile.

classifications.current_target_fact: Security contact and private disclosure channel are NOT_ASSIGNED; there is no supported version or operation.
classifications.disposition: Assign accountable security contact, private route and incident runbook before supported operation; do not publish sensitive exploit details before a verified route exists.
